summary: Implemented App.call_from_thread in src/textual/app.py, with _loop and _thread_id state initialized in __init__ and set/cleared in run_async (cleared in a finally). Added tests/test_concurrency.py with 8 tests, all passing when run with PYTHONPATH=src. Full suite excluding cli/devtools/snapshot_tests: 613 passed, 68 failed; the original source gives the same 68 failures (missing pytest-asyncio in the venv). Nothing committed. Known gap: a call already scheduled as the loop shuts down can still wait on a loop that never runs it.
